messages:
maya (DevEx): CI started failing on our unit matrix after we switched the JS SDK to be ESM-first. Local devs ok, GH Actions (mac + node16) show either `Unexpected token 'export'` or `does not provide an export named 'default'`. Repro: checkout example-app, pnpm install, pnpm test:unit.

kevin (SDK): Can you paste the failing stack + test runner config? We changed the published package to .mjs (ESM) + .cjs (CJS) with an exports map, but maybe some runners pick the wrong entry.

maya (DevEx): Failing snippet from GH Actions:
```
node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.mjs:1
export function createClient(opts) {}
^^^^^^
SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'
```
jest.config.cjs currently:
```
module.exports = {
  preset: 'ts-jest',
  testEnvironment: 'node',
  transformIgnorePatterns: ['/node_modules/']
}
```
vitest config uses `deps.inline: ['@redwood/inference-js']`.

lee (Eng): Two buckets: (1) Jest (CJS runner) by default will ignore node_modules and choke on raw ESM files. (2) Vitest can inline deps but needs esbuild/swc target config. Short fixes: add a CJS shim at package root, or whitelist the package in transformIgnorePatterns so Jest transforms it. Example Jest tweak:
```
transformIgnorePatterns: ['/node_modules/(?!(?:@redwood/inference-js)/)']
```
and add a transformer for .mjs like `@swc/jest`.

ana (QA): We also hit webcrypto missing on node16 runners: `globalThis.crypto` undefined in tests that simulate edge env. Quick polyfill in setup files fixed it locally: `const { webcrypto } = require('node:crypto'); global.crypto = webcrypto;` Add to `setupFilesAfterEnv`.

kevin (SDK): Long-term we should publish an ESM build that also re-exports a default and provide a tiny index.cjs that requires the CJS bundle so older toolchains pick it up. Example package.json exports: `{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}` and also include `index.mjs` that does `export { default } from './runtime.mjs'; export { createClient } from './runtime.mjs'`. That guarantees both `import Inference from` and `const Inference = require()` work.

maya (DevEx): I tried a test-only shim in Jest that mutates the imported module shape, but mixing require/import caused more resolver confusion. Better to use manual mocks: create `__mocks__/@redwood/inference-js.js` for Jest or use `vi.mock('@redwood/inference-js', async () => ({ createClient: async () => ({}) }))` for Vitest.

lee (Eng): Also add a tiny compatibility test into the SDK repo: run under Jest on node16 that does `const sdk = require('@redwood/inference-js');` and `import sdkDefault from '@redwood/inference-js';` to fail-fast. We'll add that to the SDK CI.

ana (QA): Plan for fixing flakes:
- kevin (SDK): add CJS shim + update exports map (PR #802).
- lee (Eng): add CI job macOS/node16 to the test matrix that runs transformed node_modules.
- ana (QA): add polyfill setup files for Jest & Vitest and manual mocks for auth paths.
- maya (DevEx): add docs snippet for `jest`/`vitest` config (transformIgnorePatterns / deps.inline / setupFiles).

gha-bot: CI matrix updated: macOS + node16 transform job added (job #214).

kevin (SDK): I'll also try to reproduce locally with node16 and the same npm lockfile to make sure the resolver picks the correct export. Will ping when PR is up.

maya (DevEx): Thanks all. If anyone else sees weird ESM/CJS test failures, paste the failing stack + package.json + jest/vitest config here and we'll triage. :mag:
